payload.title: Review Brief: Steward Dashboard Runtime View
payload.summary: Codex PR #6 has been merged into main. I reviewed the actual changed files and implementation. The delivery satisfies the requested Steward dashboard runtime view package at the implementation level.
payload.review_subject: PR #6 — Implement Steward dashboard runtime view
implementation_summary: Added src/estate/core/steward_dashboard.py as the Steward-facing dashboard generator.
Registered steward-dashboard CLI command in src/estate/cli/main.py with --json support.
ca3_findings: The implementation explicitly states the dashboard is generated from existing operational artifacts and does not create governance, lifecycle states, or new operational authority.
It consumes Operations Board output, capability lifecycle report output, worker inbox summary, audit latest output, audit result artifacts, and Operations Board Markdown where available.
Missing optional artifacts and malformed JSON are treated as warnings rather than fatal errors.
The dashboard separates active, blocked, and review-pending work when those signals are available from Operations Board artifacts.
The output includes Steward-facing warnings and items not requiring Steward action, which directly supports cognitive-load reduction.
Tests cover full input generation, missing Operations Board, malformed JSON, Markdown generation, and CLI registration/output generation.
lifecycle_assessment: Steward Dashboard Runtime View should be treated as Implemented.
Operational validation remains pending until the command is run against live Estate runtime state and the Steward confirms that it meaningfully reduces operational scanning burden.
The dashboard should remain a generated operational view, not a governance or history source of truth.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm whether this implementation satisfies WP-0007 scope.
Review whether the dashboard sections provide the right Steward-facing balance between brevity and operational visibility.
Confirm that the dashboard does not duplicate or supersede the Operations Board authority.
Determine whether any dashboard language should be tightened before operational validation.
recommended_next_validation: Review warnings and action/no-action separation for usefulness.
Decide whether the capability remains Implemented or can advance toward Operationally Validated after real-use review.
